summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync to run the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727 KB single-line bundle beginning with '// @bun @bun-cjs' that uses string-array rotation obfuscation (rotator function plus a large numeric constant table) and requires the Bun runtime to execute, preventing standard Node-based inspection. The package presents itself as a trivial 'example-js-project' containing demo folders, providing no legitimate reason to fetch an alternate language runtime at install and use it to run a large obfuscated bundle. The dropper fires automatically on npm install via the preinstall lifecycle hook, without user consent, executing opaque code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
